mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.email, c.group_id, g.name AS group_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM contact c LEFT JOIN contact_group g ON g.id = c.group_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact WHERE phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact (name, phone, email, group_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{groupId})
